preconditions.description: The number of problems n must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of experienced teams k must be between 1 and 4.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(line.split()[j]) <= 1 for i in range(n) for j in range(k))
preconditions.description: Each problem's knowledge status for each team must be either 0 or 1.

postconditions.description: The output must be either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: any(sum(row) <= k // 2 for row in problemset)
postconditions.description: There must exist a non-empty subset of problems where each team knows at most half of the problems.
